label: Bible Study
prompt: For the law was given by Moses, but _____ and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verse: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
note: Moses brought the law — grace and truth arrived in person.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are _____, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verse: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
note: Paul's mental diet plan: think on whatsoever is true, honest, just, pure, lovely, and of good report.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But the queen Vashti _____ to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
verse: But the queen Vashti refused to come at the king's commandment by his chamberlains: therefore was the king very wroth, and his anger burned in him.
note: Queen Vashti refused to appear at the king's feast — and her empty seat opened the way for Esther.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the _____ grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
verse: And he shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, even a morning without clouds; as the tender grass springing out of the earth by clear shining after rain.
note: From David's last words: a just ruler is like sunrise after rain on new grass.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without _____, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verse: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
note: Back home in Nazareth the hometown crowd took offence — and the KJV keeps the British u in 'honour.'
